title: 印度快商务先驱戈亚尔转向长周期布局
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I started Zomato as a college project. I had no idea what business meant. I didn't know what revenue meant. I didn't know the importance of anything like culture, people, being kind
segments.zh: 我大学时创办了Zomato，当时完全不懂商业、收入，也不懂文化、团队和善待他人的重要性。

segments.en: to people. I was just doing whatever felt right.
One of India's most influential tech entrepreneurs on the near of the year is Dipindar Goyal.
segments.zh: 印度最具影响力的科技企业家之一，年度人物是迪平达尔·戈亚尔。

segments.en: And among the country's youngest self-made billionaires, Dipindar Goyal scaled his college startup into a multi-billion-dollar platform, making the 10-minute delivery part of everyday
segments.zh: 作为印度最年轻的白手起家亿万富翁之一，戈亚尔将大学创业项目发展为价值数十亿美元的平台，让10分钟送达成为印度日常生活的一部分。

segments.en: life in India. But just as it looked like he had arrived, Goyal took a step away from the company he built for close to 20 years, to chase after brain trackies, peak biology,
segments.zh: 但就在看似功成名就之时，戈亚尔离开了他近20年打造的公司，去追逐脑机接口、巅峰生物学和飞行穿梭机。

segments.en: and flying shuttles. I've always been curious about how does this work, how does that work, and just the rabbit hole
segments.zh: 我一直好奇这个怎么运作、那个怎么运作，正是这种探索让我解决想解决的问题，或开展想做的业务。

segments.en: has led me to solve all the problems that I want to solve, or all the businesses that I want to bring in.
segments.zh: 这种探索让我解决想解决的问题，或开展想做的业务。

segments.en: Now the architect of quick commerce in India is building for a much longer horizon. The question is, will he ever get there?
segments.zh: 如今，印度快速商务的架构师正在为更长远的目标而建设。问题是，他能实现吗？

segments.en: More than seven acres of hidden luxury right here in Delhi and as the private residence of Dipindar Goyal, few cameras have made it in so far for a relic inside. Come with me.
